name: Clergy
overview: Scripture reveals that clergy are divinely appointed shepherds who feed the flock with knowledge and understanding, reflecting God's heart for His people, as seen in Jeremiah 3:15. Ephesians 4:11 highlights the diversity of roles within church leadership, including apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers, each given for the building up of the body of Christ. Believers are called to obey and submit to their leaders, recognizing their responsibility to watch over souls and give an account with joy, as emphasized in Hebrews 13:17. However, James 3:1 warns that those who teach will face stricter judgment, underscoring the gravity and accountability inherent in the ministry of clergy.
